(21)༄༅/ /khro phu bka' brgyud las byung ba'i phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi khrid yig bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (21)༄༅// khro phu bka' brgyud las byung ba'i phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi khrid yig bzhugs so//

(22)༄༅// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma chen po nā ro pa'i thugs kyi snying po phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi ngo sprod ni/ dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ gnyis pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom/ gsum pa yi dam lha yi nga rgyal bsgom/ bzhi pa sems nyid sangs rgyas su ngo sprod/ lnga pa dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba'o// dang po ni/ byams snying rje drag pos smon 'jug gnyis kyi byang sems snying thag pa nas lan gsum gyi bar du bsgom mo// gnyis pa ni/ nyin spyi bo dang*/ mtshan mo snying gar seng khri pad zla gsum brtsegs kyi gdan la rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can gsal bar bsgoms la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed/ gsol ba drag tu gdab bo// gsum pa ni/ rang gi lus rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor yi dam lha'i nga rgyal bskyed/ bzlas pa brgya rtsa brgyad tsam bya'o// bzhi pa ni/ ma bcos gnyug mar ngo sprad pa dang*/ rnam rtog 'od gsal du ngo sprad pa gnyis las// dang po ni/ bsam gtan gyi phyag rgya bcas la rang sems 'di bcas bcos mi bya bar lhod kyis glod/ lhan gyis bzhag /phyams kyis btang ngo*// shor sa bzhi dang*/ gol ba gsum gyi bar chad bsal/ bying rgod blos byas gsum gyi gegs bsal lo// gnyis pa ni/ de'i ngang las rnam rtog gang byung yang*/ byung ba de nyid la cer gyis bltas pas blta rgyu med de rang grol du 'gyur bas rtog pa de nyid yul sna tshogs kyi rkyen gyis snang bar shar du bcug pa ni/ gzugs sgra'i rkyen gyis ye shes rang sad pa bya ba yin/ cer gyis bltas pas blta rgyu ma rnyed pa ni/ ye shes la ye shes su rang ngo rang gis shes par bya ba yin no/ (23)lnga pa ni/ sngon 'gro gsum po bsod nams kyi tshogs so// bzhi pa dngos gzhi ye shes kyi tshogs yin pas tshogs gnyis las 'bras bu sangs pa dang rgyas pa gnyis 'byung bas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin du bsngo ste// bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag gis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog
/ces lan gsum brjod do// rje btsun dwags po rin po che'i zhal gdams rdzogs so// zhes khro phu lo tsā ba gnubs byams pa'i dpal gyi gsung rab man ngag brgya rtsa las byung ba'o/// /(24)
